args.name: Practical berry propagation
args.function: Provide a feasible reusable method to propagate an existing berry plant into an additional rooted plant, if local conditions and actual available materials permit. Distinguish propagation from watering an existing plant.
args.conditions: At tick 17 commons-berry-0-0 was mature with stock 6, capacity 20 and soil moisture 0.65. The mastered watering contract says berries require moisture 0.6, so watering is not currently indicated. Other visible berry plants have stock 20. Propagation feasibility is unknown; use subsequent observations where relevant.
args.inputs: Identify whether actual berries, cuttings, tools, soil preparation or other materials are needed. I currently own six berries; do not assume any tools, seeds or vessels exist in my inventory.
args.costs: Specify realistic study time, labor, material consumption, site requirements and growth delays. Unknown costs should be investigated rather than waived.
args.effects: If feasible, implement an actionable propagation capability requiring actual learning and physical work, with explicit establishment conditions and delayed growth. Do not grant instant harvest, guaranteed survival or mastery. If infeasible, explain the limiting requirements.

args.name: Evidence-based assessment of unfamiliar food
args.function: Provide a feasible procedure for investigating an owned unfamiliar food sample, distinguishing directly measured food properties from properties that remain unknown. The immediate problem is deciding whether local hazelnuts can safely supplement known-safe berries.
args.conditions: I observed the hazelnut plant at tick 17, but observation established only its visible state and soil conditions. Hazelnut nutrition and toxicity remain unknown to me. Berries are known to have nutrition 8 and toxicity 0; roots have nutrition 14 and toxicity 0. Do not infer food safety from the plant name or from mechanical tests.
args.inputs: An actual owned hazelnut sample if gathering succeeds. Other equipment or comparison samples are not assumed available; identify any necessary prerequisites.
args.costs: Method, time, material and equipment requirements are unknown. Prefer a small sample and low health risk. Do not consume an unknown food automatically.
args.effects: Enable actual trials or preparation that yield only justified observations about the sample. State limitations explicitly if safe nutritional or toxicity assessment is not feasible with available means. No safety finding or mastery should arise from this request alone.

candidates.function: Scoop a little river or shallow water by hand and pour it onto the soil plot of a rooted plant whose measured soil is drier than it needs.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. collect (x, y: a visible ~ or = cell whose edge is within 0.65 m of you on the bank): 1 round, 0.3 energy; fills cupped hands to 0.2 L (or an owned water vessel given as container to its capacity). water (target: a rooted growing plant in reach; quantityLitres optional, default all held, at most 0.5): 1 round, 2 energy per litre poured (at least 0.05). status (target optional): 1 round, no energy. Refused before any cost, with the measured values, when soil moisture already meets the plant requirement (berry 0.6, root 0.5, tuber 0.8, fern-root 0.7), the plot is waterlogged (hazard waterlogging above 0.1 or moisture 1.3+), the target is not a rooted plant, or no water is held.
candidates.effects: Hand water is not an item: 40% of what is left leaks at each round end and 20% per metre walked; below 0.005 L it is gone. A pour loses 20% (from a vessel 5%) outside the root zone. The rest enters the root zone of the plant cell (1 m x 1 m, shared by every plant rooted there): 30 L raise soil moisture by 1; above 1.3 it runs off; above 1 half the excess drains each round; 10% evaporates each round (at most 0.0375 L). Soil moisture, which growth reads as min(1, moisture / requirement), includes it until it is gone. Growth is not boosted or promised. No reward.

candidates.function: Crack the hard casing of your own shelled material, such as hazelnuts, in 0.1 blocks with controlled impacts of your own hard blunt striker on a stable support, and take the loose casing off opened blocks by hand to separate the kernel.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. target: your own unreserved, untreated item of a material with a represented casing (closed for crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity: exact tenths, 0.1-1 (default all, up to 1), reserved in one work (workId). Crack modes need striker (your own whole, rigid, sound inedible piece, e.g. a stone) and support (a solid inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground), pinned for the work. Per 0.1 block: one cracking round, 1 energy; in crack-and-separate a block that opens adds one separation round, 0.5 energy; separate: one hand round, 0.5 energy per block. 0.9 units: at most 18 rounds, 13.5 energy. quoteOnly true reports quantity, striker condition, phases, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost. pause, resume, cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; failed rechecks pause open work at no charge. Travel and getting a striker are separate actions.
candidates.effects: Strength is hardness / 10; an impact passes the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility). At or below the casing strength the casing is unchanged: a real paid result that ends the work, the material returns as it was. Above it a block gains damage (load - strength) / strength: below 1 closed and damaged (a reattempt is new work), at 1 fractured open. Separation takes an opened block apart into 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments (a unit of each is that part of one whole unit) with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel carries all food value and toxicity, whatever they are. Opened blocks not separated stay cracked unseparated material. Wear: a striker no harder than what it strikes, or a support softer by 0.5 than what presses on it, loses 0.0001 kg per contact. Cancel returns reserved material as it now is; death leaves it at the worksite. Nothing is refunded, made safe or eaten; edibility, nutrition and toxins stay unknown; no reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability search found watering and casing separation, neither of which creates an additional rooted plant. Watering commons-berry-0-0 at its measured moisture 0.65 is not indicated by the berry requirement 0.6. Develop a general seed-propagation operation, initially supporting extraction and sowing trials where the represented plant biology permits them. Seed presence, viability, germination requirements and growth timing must be resolved in the current development handoff, not inferred from the name 'berry' or replaced by an instant plant grant.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: propagate from seed, parameterized by owned source item, quantity, accessible planting site and work ID, with extract, sow, inspect, pause, resume and cancel modes. Initial scope is hand extraction and shallow sowing of seeds that can actually be separated by hand; this does not presume tools, vessels, suitable cuttings or seeds in inventory. Exact immediate source candidate: item-6-lin-57, six berries owned by lin, origin commons-berry-0-0. Recheck its surviving quantity, decay and ownership at execution; do not consume all six by default. commons-berry-0-0 is a parent reference, not a supply of free cuttings or permission to damage it. The later tick-20 observation still reports stock 6 and moisture 0.65; other plants' fruit stocks do not establish propagation feasibility.\\nDevelopment handoff must inspect the existing biological representation and related handlers before coding. Reuse and record applicable inventory, observation, soil, growth, decay and work code by exact handler/revision where available; recorded related contracts include rooted-plant-watering, forest.gather at foundation-forest@1, and open.probe at foundation-open@1. Do not claim their implementation as new invention. Missing seed separation, seed identity, sowing or establishment mechanisms belong in this same handoff. Add only the minimum coherent seed lifecycle needed; do not add an unrelated toolmaking or agriculture roadmap. If berry seed anatomy or germination cannot yet be supported by justified biological parameters, implement the actual extraction/site-inspection precursor and report the precise remaining dependency rather than generating a rooted plant.\\nProposed work costs: learning 4 active study rounds; each study round uses 0.2 energy, with ordinary hunger/time continuing. One extraction attempt uses one whole surviving berry, one active round and 0.5 energy. It produces only seeds actually represented inside that berry plus its separated pulp/residue; retain source age, decay and lineage, and partition the original material mass rather than multiplying it. Viability is initially unknown. An extraction yielding no seed is a paid, informative failure, not a seed grant. No food value may remain duplicated across source, seeds and residue. A non-destructive planting-site inspection uses one round and 0.2 energy. Sowing up to the seeds obtained from that berry uses two work rounds and 1 energy per round: first prepare a small hand-workable patch, then place seeds and cover it. Hard ground, inaccessible sites, unsuitable soil or a preparation requiring absent equipment must fail preflight without charging the unperformed phase. No vessel, imported soil, fertilizer, water, tool or reserved land is supplied. Any additional material requirement must be quoted from the actual method and supplied before execution; otherwise that method is unavailable.\\nBefore sowing is enabled, the handoff must supply executable species-specific sowing depth, spacing, permissible soil and temperature conditions, germination delay and establishment/maturity thresholds, grounded in the actual biology/model rather than fruit stock. These unresolved values are development dependencies, not zero costs or an arbitrary fixed-era unlock. Persist elapsed eligible growth time, seed condition, moisture exposure, failures and lineage. Soil requirements must be explicit; do not silently treat moisture 0.6 for an established berry as a proven germination requirement. Every actual seed is transferred from inventory to a site record. A rooted seedling is created only after a real successful establishment transition; its initial fruit stock is zero. Growth and later fruit production require the existing growth model or an explicitly implemented compatible extension with accounted substrate, water and environmental energy inputs. Neither this review nor waiting for development advances time.\\nWork stores actor, exact source/site IDs, reserved quantities, completed phases and costs. Recheck reach, ownership, site availability and prerequisites before each paid phase. Pause on interruption; resume only remaining labor after revalidation. Cancel releases unprocessed reservations once, preserving already separated material, prepared ground and sown seeds. Spent energy, elapsed time and consumed/degraded material are not refunded. Death cancels actor work, releases surviving carried work materials at the worksite under ordinary death rules, and does not erase already sown seeds. Germination, decay and established growth continue during ordinary world time independently of the actor; global simulation pauses freeze them. Maintenance is actual inspection and, only when indicated and independently performed, watering through rooted-plant-watering using real water and its existing costs. Do not invoke another participant or grant skill automatically. Implement all resolved checks and transitions in code, not recurring model review.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"No benefit for the request, development, naming, study completion or mastery. A completed extraction, measured site investigation, informative failed trial or observed establishment may count only when it gives lin personally new, evidence-backed information. Familiar successful care may support modest satisfaction without requiring novelty. For any such implemented credit, use the existing experience mechanism with functional deduplication by lineage/site, property and evidence event; at most one short-pleasure increment of 0.01 and one maintained-satisfaction increment of 0.01 per qualifying event, combined propagation contribution capped at 0.1, cooldown 10 rounds per equivalent result, satisfaction decay 0.002 per ordinary round. Repeated status queries and unobserved background growth earn nothing. No physical-comfort award is proposed; physical comfort remains capped at 10. Do not change basic nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable, timestamped extraction, sowing, inspection, establishment, failure and death events only when those actions or transitions occur. Reusable visual metadata must include work ID, source lineage, site position, phase, completed/required labor, visible material state, plant stage and evidence ID. Distinguish unverified seed, sown patch, emerged seedling and established plant. Failed extraction shows no seed product; sowing is not displayed as a rooted plant, and interrupted work never displays completion. Growth may exist without immediate personal knowledge; update personal records only through an actual observation.\"},{\"actor\":\"ivo\",\"decision\":\"reuse\",\"ability\":\"probe\",\"reason\":\"The existing probe directly covers observation and small physical trials on an owned unfamiliar sample, including this request's feasible low-risk precursor. Ivo now actually owns item-20-ivo-201, one hazelnut gathered at tick 20; gathering is no longer merely hypothetical. Probe does not provide a nutritional or toxicological assay, and neither the food name nor a mechanical result establishes safety. Casing separation is a distinct existing operation, not grounds for inventing a new assessment skill or assuming its tools are present.\",\"specification\":\"Reuse probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1. Preserve its exact parameter interface: target string, mode observe/press/wet/heat, intensity number 0 through 1, with no additional parameters. Initial applicable call targets item-20-ivo-201 in observe mode; only visible properties are reportable. Observe costs one round and 0.2 energy. A physical trial costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual sample unit. Each execution is one interaction, not a continuing investigation or automatic sequence. Retain source start-1-nuts, harvest tick 20 and inherited decay. No automatic ingestion, tasting, toxin exposure or health challenge is authorized.\\nObserve may establish only actually visible color, casing condition, visible spoilage or other directly accessible features. Press may establish only the actual response at the chosen intensity. A failure to open or deform the casing is evidence of that trial, not evidence of safety or poor nutrition. Wet and heat require actual water or heat access and any necessary safe handling materials; none is established here. Keep existing executable checks and handlers; missing enforcement is an implementation correction, not a new claimed invention.\",\"learning\":0,\"experienceReview\":\"Preserve probe's existing effects; this review grants no new reward.
